title: The Cantor Hall Room Mix-Up, Tina's Daybed in Luray, & Leaving RRC After Twelve Days
description: When Cantor Hall's room assignments are scrambled on Wednesday night and Center red tape forces staff to blindly follow the printout, Nate rescues Katie from Chris, Thursday's chaos cancels their closet write-up meeting with their counselor while the administration sweeps Natalie's assault under the rug, and on Friday afternoon Tina folds their manual wheelchairs into her compact sedan for Luray—where Katie and Nate call Dad to pack up their rooms for good.
